thread:
Anna K: Hey folks — need to lock a 45m slot for an inference bench readout next week (latency + cost optimizations). Proposed times: Tue 3/24 10:00-10:45 PT or Wed 3/25 13:00-13:45 PT. Can you +1 availability or suggest alternatives?

Samir P: +1 for Tue morning, prefer Tue.

Devon R: Wed works better for infra changes I'm landing. If Tue, I'll be remote and might miss the last 10m.

Liam C: Tue ok but need to prep the KV-cache slides. Can we add "regression test results" to agenda?

Maria S: +1 Wed preferred. Also can someone post the current latency/cost dash link?

Anna K: link: https://redwood.prod/dashboards/infer/latency-cost (internal) — please check the "p95-by-model" and "token-cost-by-route" panels before the readout.

Samir P: quick ask — can we put this on the weekly perf rota so the same reviewers attend? Also want canary results included (model v1.2 -> v1.3).

Devon R: code review ping — PR 4523 needs a quick look for the batching flag change. @Liam C @Maria S PTAL. Diff: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4523

Liam C: ack, I'll take it after standup.

Maria S: re: dashboards — CSV export is here: https://redwood.prod/dashboards/export?board=infer&range=7d — I exported a trimmed table to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/dirs/1AaBbCc/perf-readout-prep

Anna K: draft agenda:
- 5m: quick status + roll call
- 15m: benchmark readout (p50/p95, token cost)
- 10m: optimization proposals (batching, quantized variants)
- 10m: rollout/canary plan & action items

Any items to add?

Samir P: add "failover behavior under region loss" — we saw weird retries yesterday.

Devon R: add "KV cache hit-rate analysis" and brief on PR 4523 implications.

Anna K: updated agenda noted. Also: please run this script against the perf dataset before meeting:
```bash
python tools/perf_bench_analyze.py --start=2026-03-15 --end=2026-03-21 --models "gpt-small,gpt-medium" --format=summary
```
Outputs under /tmp/perf-summary.json

Liam C: small FYI — I'll bring a quick perf table that isolates tokenization overhead.

infra-bot: Calendar event created: "Inference bench readout" Tue Mar 24 10:00 PT — attendees: Anna K, Samir P, Liam C, Maria S, Devon R. Invite: https://calendar.redwood/events/abcd1234

Anna K: If you can't make Tue please react with :x: and propose times. If we have >2 :x: let's move to Wed.

Maria S: :x: — Wed 13:00 works.

Samir P: :thumbsup: for Tue.

Devon R: :x: prefer Wed.

Liam C: :thumbsup: 

Anna K: Looks like split — final poll: Tue 10:00 (2 thumbs) vs Wed 13:00 (2 x) — can the product folks chime in? @Jules P @Korey L

Jules P: Tue preferred from product side.

Korey L: Either is fine for me.

Anna K: Okay locking Tue 10:00 PT then. One more ask: please paste a short 2-line summary of any blocking infra concerns in this thread by EOD Friday.

Samir P: I'm blocked on GPU queueing spikes in us-west-2 from model loading; will paste details.

Devon R: I'll post KV cache numbers and a short note on PR 4523.

Maria S: I'll share regression harness results.

Anna K: Thanks — see you all Tue. Agenda + drive folder pinned to the event.
